items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) is back in focus after Biohaven entered a new clinical supply agreement to pair BHV-1530 with Regeneron’s cancer drug Libtayo in patients with solid tumors, with enrollment in the combination cohort already underway. Despite today’s pullback, with the share price down 4.54% over the past day to US$752.25 and weaker recent momentum, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals still carries a 90 day share price return of 20.64% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 34.84%...

items.title: What Does Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) Need To Prove In Eye Disease Now?
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGS: REGN) faces fresh pressure after Kodiak Sciences reported new Phase 3 data on its eye drugs. Kodiak said Zenkuda and tabirafusp alfa tedromer matched Eylea on primary Phase 3 endpoints for macular degeneration treatment. The trial reported similar vision outcomes with Kodiak's candidates given roughly every six months versus Eylea's current eight week dosing interval.
